cross_platform_interpretation: no quantile-to-equal-ability mapping; native source ranks are not assumed equivalent

existing_labels.use: evaluation_only; never difficulty truth or fit data

method_limits: Empirical ranks describe observed native distributions and do not establish comparable ability.
Bootstrap intervals quantify finite-catalog sampling variation only; they do not model source or label uncertainty.
Topic-conditioned rank shifts are descriptive and can reflect category composition, selection, or tag coverage.
No difficulty ordering or target is present in the semantic relevance labels; no supervised calibration was fitted.
Split partitions are prospective and problem-group disjoint; all current labeled-pair endpoints remain evaluation-only.

atcoder.scale_interpretation: AtCoder Problems community estimate; not AtCoder-native and not Codeforces-equivalent

leetcode.scale_interpretation: ordinal native category only; Easy < Medium < Hard is the published category order

resampling.interval: 2.5th to 97.5th percentile of bootstrap quantile landmarks

split_plan.assignment: existing semantic-evaluation endpoints are eval-only; remaining groups use SHA-256 buckets 70/15/15
split_plan.identity_group_rule: reviewed representative_key aliases only; duplicate-title candidates remain separate
split_plan.platform_source_disjointness: not_claimed; partitions are within-platform problem groups, and source scales remain separate

topic_rule.atcoder_topic_analysis: unavailable: native tags are not present
topic_rule.diagnostic: absolute shift between global and topic-conditioned midrank; not truth error
